title: Developed my own kalshi trading system
author: EntertainmentSalt825
selftext:
Been working on a solo project developing a kalshi trading system for 15min btc contracts. So far it’s composed of 2 algo bots. One is more trigger happy but less accurate than the other.  
Out of 177 kalshi contracts the least efficient bot has correctly predicted the close of a contract 8min before with 86% accuracy. The more reserved bot fires less often and has a prediction rate of 91%.  
I’ve don’t backtesting and live validation. I’ve not yet built enough confidence on every signal it produces while live testing, but in the few that I have it’s been right. I’ve turned $50 into $300+ in a few weeks. How long it will hold? Only time will tell but for now it’s a profitable proof of concept

comments.author: MundaneFishing8143
comments.body: Nice what is the average daily profit percentage on this thing or have you not run it live long enough yet to know

replies.author: EntertainmentSalt825
replies.body: Haven’t calculated an average daily yet. From the live testing, I’ve been averaging about 15-20% return per contract (on the signals I actually trade on). Today’s profit is at 43%. Still building confidence with the system. Once there’s more confidence then I’ll automate it a bit more to start trading fully on its own

replies.author: MundaneFishing8143
replies.body: Thats nice but you dont won every contract right which is why I would want to know what it comes to after all wins and loses are considered in live playing after enough sample with a low luck factor

replies.author: EntertainmentSalt825
replies.body: That is correct, I can’t win every contract but I can get very close. The way I setup my approach, it does not score a single contract on one signal. I have a few signals within the 15min contract. The percentage on the report is scoring all of those checkpoints within the contracts. Which is why you’ll see 177 contracts and 870 predictions. If you want to know the metric of the contract per one signal fired then there’s actually a few metrics I can provide from that alone haha. If you want to know the win rate per contract, then for the least efficient bot, it’s contract win rate on a single checkpoint is 166/177 (\~94% win rate). However this doesn’t mean that this signal alone has the best returns. Now if you want to know how many contracts hit every signal correctly within per contract then for the most accurate bot the win rate is 57/65 (87%).

comments.author: marketshooter
comments.body: That's a really cool project. I'd be especially interested in seeing how it performs over a much larger sample size and during different market conditions.

comments.author: narutoaerowindy
comments.body: I have been struggling to find a strategy in these BTC 15min predictions.

replies.author: EntertainmentSalt825
replies.body: It’s difficult. But I would suggest you first understand if your strategy works best during high, medium or low volatility. I found my bots degrade in high volatile markets so i only trade at specific time intervals

replies.author: narutoaerowindy
replies.body:
One of my strategies is to

"Check for swinging high edge to low edge of Bollinger bands on 1min, 5min, 15min TF and predict. Vice versa"

comments.author: FortuneGrouchy4701
comments.body: Are you using any prediction model for this strategies like XGBoost to train and predict?

replies.author: EntertainmentSalt825
replies.body: 0 prediction models. My system is purely deterministic code with my own tests, fixtures, and walk forward boundaries. Once I get a solid baseline with consistent results then I plan on integrating ML

comments.body: I spent a few weeks trying to develop one. I found in my experience that the sweet spot was between 8 to 3 minutes left but i still couldn't nail down something that won more then 75% of the time. Good luck brother.

replies.author: EntertainmentSalt825
replies.body: 75% is already pretty good though? Was it not consistent? Sounds like you knew the sweet spot and had a decent win rate. You just needed a little bit of fine tuning
